description: I'm Manuel Guilherme, a software and security engineer in Blumenau, Brazil. I build with NASA data, Rust, Python and JavaScript. Our project, moonseal, finds the right day to land at the Moon's south pole from JPL Horizons and LRO LOLA data, tells whether a lander there would have a signal to Earth, checked live against NASA's Deep Space Network, and seals each finding, post-quantum signed, on Solana devnet. Looking for: planetary science, mission design, radio links and data visualization.
